_disclaimer: This data is manually curated. Verify fees and procedures at the specific court registry before filing.

possession_suit.applicable_law: Code of Civil Procedure, 1908 + Transfer of Property Act
possession_suit.court_fees_formula: Based on property value: 1% up to ₹15,000, graduated scale thereafter
steps: File suit for possession with title documents
Commission may be appointed for local inspection
possession_suit.punjab_specific_notes: District courts have jurisdiction. Revenue courts handle agricultural land disputes.

injunction_property.court_fees_formula: Fixed court fee ₹50-100 plus ad valorem
injunction_property.limitation_calculation: From date of first interference with property rights
injunction_property.punjab_specific_notes: Common in urban areas for boundary disputes and construction interference.

documents_required: No court fee for revenue matters
revenue_court_mutation.court_fees_formula: No court fee in revenue courts
revenue_court_mutation.limitation_calculation: From date of knowledge of mutation
steps: May go to collector, then commissioner
revenue_court_mutation.punjab_specific_notes: Revenue courts handle land records. Appeals go through revenue hierarchy.

partition_suit.limitation_period: No specific limitation, but reasonable time
partition_suit.limitation_calculation: No fixed period, but laches may apply
partition_suit.punjab_specific_notes: Commissioner appointed for actual division. Common in joint Hindu family properties.
